httpd.listen.description: IP address and port on which the HTTP daemon listens (e.g., '0.0.0.0:80' or '[::]:80')

httpd.max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections the server will handle

httpd.max_requests_per_child.description: Maximum number of requests a child process handles before being respawned (0 = unlimited)

httpd.timeout.description: Time in seconds before a request times out (including receive, process, and send)

httpd.document_root.description: Base directory from which web content is served

httpd.server_admin.description: Email address displayed in server-generated error pages

httpd.server_name.description: Canonical hostname for this server (used for redirects and identification)

httpd.ssl_certificate_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format); required if SSL is enabled

httpd.ssl_private_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format); required if SSL is enabled

httpd.directory_index.description: List of default filenames to serve when a directory is requested

path.description: Filesystem path to the directory to configure

allow_override.description: Which directives may appear in .htaccess files (e.g., 'All', 'AuthConfig', 'FileInfo')

httpd.directory_configs.description: List of directory-specific access and behavior configurations

address.description: IP address or '*' to bind to all interfaces

port.description: Port for this virtual host (e.g., 80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)

server_name.description: Hostname this virtual host responds to

document_root.description: Document root specific to this virtual host

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS for this virtual host

ssl_certificate_file.description: Path to SSL certificate for this virtual host (if SSL enabled)

ssl_private_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key for this virtual host (if SSL enabled)

httpd.virtual_hosts.description: List of named virtual hosts (required for name-based virtual hosting)
